rendererComparison.initialVisualAssessment: Diagonal corridor bands in Vulkan and RTX, absent from GLx/retail.
rendererComparison.initialControlConclusion: Disabling shadows or dynamic lighting separately leaves both sampled corridor images pixel-identical to the Vulkan baseline. The early Tuvok shadow image does change with cg_shadows 0. Cause remains open.
rendererComparison.status: Initial backend-specific visual assessment retracted by full-resolution measurements.
rendererComparison.definition: All 640x480 RGB channels, 0..255; no masks, resizing, alignment or frame selection.
rendererComparison.conclusion: Both Vulkan and RTX corridor samples 80/160 agree with GLx within one channel value everywhere (MAE 0.002663 and 0.002692). These images do not establish a Vulkan/RTX-specific corridor defect. Dynamic ship/effect frames and native phase differences remain unsynchronized.
